Based on the visual inspection of the time series plot, there is a distinct structural break or level shift anomaly. The data fluctuates around a mean of roughly 0-5 mm for the first part of the series and then abruptly jumps to a higher range of roughly 12-16 mm.

This jump occurs at approximately x = 485 and continues until the end of the plotted data.

Therefore, the detected range of anomalies is:
`[[485, 730]]`
